newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bullion markets closed local festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian bullion markets closed local festival.

text.p: Indian bullion markets were closed on Thursday for a local festival, dealers said.

On Wednesday, silver prices opened on a weak note and extended losses towards the close on higher supplies of imported metal. "The weak trend in the world market also prompted scattered profit-taking," one dealer said.
"Sentiment remained subdued at the close as traders expect more inflow in the coming days," another broker said.
"Gold, on the other hand, remained firm during the day on seasonal support and shortage of ready stock," he added.
Prices of gold biscuits (116.50 gramme) settled 100 rupees higher at 60,600 rupees per piece.
